payload.final_answer: To help you plan a memorable surprise birthday party for your friend, here are the popular websites and main keywords related to 'birthday party ideas': ### Popular Websites for Inspiration: - **Pinterest.com** (Great for visual themes and DIY projects) - **Marthastewart.com** (Excellent for sophisticated party planning and decor) - **Catchmyparty.com** & **Karaspartyideas.com** (Fantastic for real-life party inspiration and themes) - **Partycity.com**, **Shindigz.com**, **Birthdayinabox.com**, & **Orientaltrading.com** (Useful for purchasing supplies and decorations) - **Evite.com** (Helpful for digital invitations and guest management) - **Partydelights.co.uk** (A great resource for party supplies) ### Main Keywords for Further Research: - Party - Ideas - Birthday Using these keywords in combination with specific interests (e.g., 'surprise birthday party ideas for adults' or 'DIY birthday party themes') on the sites listed above should provide you with plenty of inspiration for your event.
